suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-08-10. These CVEs are currently reported against org.apache.qpid:proton-j:0.34.1, which is pulled transitively by org.apache.qpid:qpid-jms-client:2.10.0. Qpid JMS 2.10.0 and Proton-J 0.34.1 are the current Apache Qpid releases, so there is no newer drop-in dependency available at review time. This library uses Qpid JMS as a client for controlled Azure Service Bus messaging, not as a public AMQP listener. Keep this suppression narrowly scoped to proton-j 0.34.1 and revisit once Apache publishes clearer CVE/fixed-version guidance or a newer Qpid JMS/Proton-J release is available.
